passover.text: For Christ, our Passover lamb, has been sacrificed.

unleavened.text: Therefore let us keep the feast, not with old leaven, the leaven of malice and wickedness, but with the unleavened bread of sincerity and truth.

firstfruits.text: But in fact Christ has been raised from the dead, the firstfruits of those who have fallen asleep.

pentecost.text: And they were all filled with the Holy Spirit and began to speak in other tongues as the Spirit gave them utterance.

trumpets.text: In a moment, in the twinkling of an eye, at the last trumpet. For the trumpet will sound, and the dead will be raised imperishable, and we shall be changed.

atonement.text: For on this day shall atonement be made for you to cleanse you. You shall be clean before the LORD from all your sins.

tabernacles.text: On the last day of the feast, the great day, Jesus stood up and cried out, If anyone thirsts, let him come to me and drink.

assembly.text: And the Word became flesh and dwelt among us, and we have seen his glory, glory as of the only Son from the Father, full of grace and truth.
